productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I was in search of a phone having neat basic requirements. My conditions are battery life ,camera and storage. Other features are complementary for me. I think that average phone user need only these functions. Afterall I'm not a gamer.I came to it's a gaming phn .Any way I tried searching new  devices. Iniitially my budget range was 30k but unfortunately I couldn't rely on this.During this period of time I came to know about IQOO and googled the details . I came to know it's the subbrand of Vivo. I was happy.I searched Amazon and fixed IQOO z9x which is budget frndly and having nice basic features.I was impressed with 6k mah battery backup.I chose dark colour . Storage is only 128gb and the camera is fine not too good. Within this prize range, we cannot expect more.I'm satisfied with product. Waiting for Indian release of IQOO 13 on dec 5.After all,  I want to point out some cons of this device.The speakers of this device is compromised.Receiver of our call can hear our voice beautifuly. No issues. But I feel it's not up to mark for us. There is a limitation and unsatisfaction during calling especially in a town area or a crowd even in full volume.Next is actual speaker of this device. It needs improvement because the sound played during YouTube or any other video player is unsatisfactory. When compared to my previous redmi device I feel it's not upto mark.My main unsatisfactory points are related to this device stereo. Others are ok.

Product Review: iQOO Z9x 5G (Tornado Green, 6GB RAM, 128GB Storage)I recently upgraded to the iQOO Z9x 5G, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations! Here’s a breakdown of my experience:Performance:Equipped with the Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 processor and 6GB of RAM, this phone delivers smooth performance across the board. Whether I’m gaming, multitasking, or streaming videos, everything runs seamlessly without lag. The Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 handles demanding apps with ease, making it a reliable choice for heavy users.Display:The display is stunning! The vibrant colors and sharp resolution make everything look amazing, from photos to videos. The 6.67-inch screen size is perfect for viewing content, and I appreciate the immersive experience it offers, especially for gaming and watching movies.Camera:The camera performance is impressive, especially for the price point. The photos come out sharp and vibrant, even in low light conditions. I’ve been enjoying capturing moments with the various shooting modes available, which add a creative touch to my photography.Design:The Tornado Green color is sleek and eye-catching. The design feels premium, and the matte finish not only looks great but also minimizes fingerprints. It’s comfortable to hold and fits nicely in my hand, making it easy to use.Battery Life:The battery life is solid, easily lasting me through a full day of heavy use. The fast charging feature is a major plus, allowing me to quickly top up when I’m in a hurry.Storage:With 128GB of storage, I have plenty of space for apps, photos, and videos. The option to expand storage further with a microSD card is a nice bonus.Overall Impression:The iQOO Z9x 5G is a fantastic smartphone that combines performance, style, and value. It’s perfect for anyone looking for a reliable device without breaking the bank. I highly recommend it!Rating: 5/5 Stars
